title: Sireso - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Sireso is a physical-element weapon used by Gustave / Verso. It scales with Vitality (B), Agility (C).

sections.title: How to Get the Sireso
sections.content:
Location: Sirene - defeat the Chromatic Greatsword Cultist.

Obtained from Sirene - defeat the Chromatic Greatsword Cultist.

sections.title: Is the Sireso Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Vitality (B), Agility (C). A physical-scaling weapon, so it fits any build that is not committed to a specific element.
